These are original synthetic test documents, released under CC0-1.0.
The embedded DejaVu font license is included in FONT-LICENSE.txt.

`single-column.pdf` is the shared ingestion fixture from rustypaper's
`python/tests/fixtures/generate.py`. It contains no actual research or citations.
Regenerate it there and copy the result here when changing the contract.
The ordinary test suite always exercises this file with the installed converter.

For the optional archive corpus, set `RUSTYPAPER_CORPUS` explicitly.
